scan.summary: This is the Oregon Liquor and Cannabis Commission's recreational marijuana producer license for Evergreen Botanicals, LLC at their Eugene location. It authorizes marijuana production at 2210 Bailey Hill Road under a Tier II Indoor license with a 10,000 square foot canopy limit, valid from March 3, 2026 through March 2, 2027. The license is subject to five conditions covering premises exclusivity, annual renewal, Cannabis Tracking System compliance, video surveillance, and reporting of ownership changes.
scan.freshness_note: This permit is current as of today (2026-09-25) and will expire March 2, 2027. A renewal application with fee must be submitted to the Commission no later than February 10, 2027 (20 days before expiration) to avoid a lapse in authorization.
